exposure: Haemolysis, Elevated Liver enzymes, Low Platelet count (HELLP) syndrome
cohort: The cohort consisted of 156 patients diagnosed with Acute Kidney Injury (AKI) during pregnancy or the peripartum period, admitted to a tertiary care hospital in India between January 2014 and December 2021.
finding: Pregnancy-Related Acute Kidney Injury (PRAKI) was associated with poor maternal and neonatal outcomes, with Pregnancy Induced Hypertension (PIH) and sepsis being the leading causes.
